options.text: Lineage members refuse to remember their parents
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

detailedSolution:

Lineage members can trace every generational link backward to a known ancestor, whereas clan ancestors recede into remote mythical antiquity

Hence Option B is correct.
